top_news.title: Coverage, Not Difficulty, Sets How Much Synthetic Data an Activation Probe Needs
top_news.dek: Activation probe data requirements are driven by the complexity of the concept being monitored rather than the difficulty of the task.
top_news.brief: Researchers analyzed learning curves for activation probes across various synthetic datasets. They found that probes for high-stakes or harmful content reach performance plateaus with as few as 80 samples, while instruction-following probes require significantly more data to achieve similar stability.
top_news.image_alt: Graph showing learning curves for activation probes

top_news.title: Anthropic: An opt-in vulnerability-finding service for open-source software
top_news.dek: Anthropic has launched an opt-in vulnerability scanning service for open-source software projects.
top_news.brief: The new OSS Scanner leverages Anthropic's latest models to perform periodic security audits on participating open-source repositories. The service is free and builds on the company's internal research into automated vulnerability discovery.
top_news.image_alt: Anthropic OSS Scanner logo and interface

top_news.title: OpenAI uncovers Russian and Iranian influence ops that planted fake stories in real news outlets
top_news.dek: OpenAI identified and banned Russian and Iranian influence operations that used fake journalists to plant stories in legitimate media.
top_news.brief: The operations bypassed social media, instead focusing on placing content directly into established news outlets. The Russian 'Dark Clark' campaign and Iranian 'Bogus Bylines' operation used AI-generated personas to distribute disinformation, marking a shift toward infiltrating traditional media channels.

top_news.title: WAF, Rules - Failed detections field available in Rules
top_news.dek: Cloudflare introduced a new field to allow granular control over requests when security detections fail.
top_news.brief: The new 'cf.appsec.request.failed_detections' field provides an array of detection IDs for failed security checks, including AI prompt injections, PII leaks, and WAF signatures. Developers can now write custom rules to handle these specific failure states without altering existing detection logic.

top_news.title: Whistle: Speech to Text in 16.9 MB
top_news.dek: Whistle is a 16.9 MB speech-to-text model designed for edge devices and microcontrollers.
top_news.brief: The model supports seven languages and runs entirely on CPU with no external dependencies. It is designed to integrate with the Needle engine, allowing developers to combine speech recognition and tool calling within a single lightweight binary.
